rules.rule: Watch (L3) needs early holder density that holds through the first fade; an mcap spike alone isn't enough.
rules.title: Watch needs holder density that survives the first fade

rules.rule: KOTH loss + curve progress reversing + holder bleed = Pass (L1).
rules.title: Pass on a KOTH loss with curve and holders reversing

rules.rule: Copycats appearing often mark peak attention for the original.
rules.title: Copycats mark peak attention for the original

rules.rule: Solada headline 24h volume can be stale post-graduation; check real pool flow over the last 6h.
rules.title: Check real pool flow, not stale headline volume

rules.rule: Holders > trades suggests airdrop/bridge/bundle distribution.
rules.title: More holders than trades points to airdrop or bundles

rules.rule: Graduation alone isn't a signal: JUICE, FEED, HERO, BEAST all faded to 19-30k ADA with 60-80 holders after pools opened.
rules.title: Graduation alone is not a signal

rules.rule: Pools with an ADA side under ~11k swing 30-80% on a handful of wallets; holder count is the signal.
rules.title: Pools under ~11k ADA side swing on a few wallets

rules.rule: Price rising with flat holders = Tiny lottery (L2) at best.
rules.title: Rising price on flat holders caps at Tiny lottery

rules.rule: Linked flip pair u8a2m6+u978t4 and snipers u9w6dd/uytg09zr/uyyyjqps in the first block = rotation risk; watch whether they sell into the run.
rules.title: Flip pair and first-block snipers mean rotation risk

rules.rule: First-block sniper full exit = kill trigger; IAGONAUT faded 47.8k→32.2k within ~45 min after top sniper uytg09zr sold out (Oct 17).
rules.title: Exit when the first-block sniper sells out

rules.rule: Holding-tier shape: only names with 120+ holders, ADA-side ≥25k and 6h buys > sells qualify for paper tickets; post-graduation names under ~11k ADA side with 6h price down >40% (HERO -76%, JUICE -41%, ROBIN -55%) are Pass regardless of 24h headline gains.
rules.title: Holding tier: 120+ holders, 25k ADA side, 6h flow up

rules.rule: Promo-pop entries: don't ticket a name whose last 6h gain came from a promo/perk announcement on flat holders. Wait for the pullback and a re-hold. BOLT opened at 530k right after the copy-trade-bot promo (+12%) and hit its 450k kill within ~2h (-20.6%) while holders barely moved.
rules.title: Skip promo-pop gains on flat holders

rules.rule: Team airdrops inflate holder counts: holders gained during a team airdrop window (CLOVE 3M+ airdrop, Oct 17) don't count toward rule k or L3 holder growth.
rules.title: Team airdrop holders don't count as growth

rules.rule: Solana-side snipe hunt: Solada's holder count for Solana-side coins mixes both chains (CORE shows 119 on Solada vs ~35 Solana holders on pump.fun). Score Solana traction on pump.fun/Helius Solana-native holders, excluding the Solada escrow wallet HCYvN1... and deployer A1qaJW....
rules.title: Score Solana-side coins on native holders

rules.rule: Count-based flow and holder leaks: 'buys > sells' counts only if h6 price change is also >= -10% (FTR showed 2,665 buys/1,584 sells over h6 while price fell 34%; BOLT 104/49 at -14.5%). Close an open ticket early when holders fall at two marks in a row and price is below entry, instead of waiting for the kill line: FTR bled 18,434 -> 18,111 -> 17,599 holders into its -34.5% kill, and CLOVE 128 -> 126 -> 123 (closed -12.7%).
rules.title: Exit after two holder drops below entry

rules.rule: Swarm launchers: early-swarm keys now launch coins themselves. uyt8xs9q (early in CRAWJI) launched PPC at 8:37 PM with u9w6dd/uxfernv7/uxz6fvju in its first blocks; u9rwdkfjtr launched HUMAN and DINO 8 min apart and uxz5cts5ww launched RED and RBULL 6 min apart, with flip pair u8a2m6+u978t4 early in all four. A launch whose launcher is a swarm key, or with 2+ swarm keys in its first 10 buyers, is L1 until it shows 60+ holders outside the swarm list.
rules.source: run 2026-10-17 21:18 (9 of 9 new Cardano launches swarm-sniped, all back to 0-1 holders)
rules.title: Swarm-launched coins stay Pass until 60 outside holders

rules.rule: Solana-side snipe hunt: team-driven King/Queen-of-the-hill pushes move the curve and Solada's mixed holder count, not Solana-native holders. MISS went 68.8% -> 83.7% curve and 90 -> 106 Solada holders on its own team's 'Queen of the hill' posts, but only 8 -> 17 Solana-native holders. An early-snipe ticket needs 50+ Solana-native holders (rule n) and 20%+ native growth between two runs, not curve % alone.
rules.title: Curve pushes need native holder growth, not curve %

rules.rule: Wallet tracking: Solada holder-reward claims add tokens (a single claim can return the platform token plus several reward tokens for a small net ADA cost). Check whether a balance increase came from a reward-claim tx before calling it a buy.
rules.title: Rule out reward claims before reading a balance increase
